# CalendarView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasCalendarView` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasDatePicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasDatePicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasDatePicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Date, date range, month grid

## Overview

A standalone, always-visible calendar grid. Can be embedded in any container (inline philosophy) or hosted inside an UltraCanvasDatePicker popup.

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasDatePicker](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasDatePicker.md)
- [UltraCanvasSmoothScroll](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasSmoothScroll.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasCalendarView> CreateCalendarView( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasCalendarView(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasCalendarView(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasCalendarView(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onDateSelected` | `std::function<void(const UCDate&)> onDateSelected` | Single/Multiple: a date was (de)selected |
| `onRangeSelected` | `std::function<void(const UCDate&, const UCDate&)> onRangeSelected` | Range/Week: a span was completed |
| `onMultipleChanged` | `std::function<void(const std::vector<UCDate>&)> onMultipleChanged` | Multiple: full set after a toggle |
| `onDateActivated` | `std::function<void(const UCDate&)> onDateActivated` | commit gesture (host should close popup) |
| `onVisibleMonthChanged` | `std::function<void(int, int)> onVisibleMonthChanged` | (year, month) when the visible month changes |
| `SetDateEnabledPredicate()` | `void SetDateEnabledPredicate(std::function<bool(const UCDate&)> pred)` | Takes a callback. |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### struct `UCDate`

A pure value type (no time-of-day). month is 1-12, day is 1-31. A default-constructed UCDate (year == 0) is treated as "empty/invalid".

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `year` | `int year = 0` |  |
| `month` | `int month = 0` |  |
| `day` | `int day = 0` |  |

Methods: `IsValid`, `IsEmpty`, `DayOfWeek`, `ISOWeek`, `ToOrdinal`, `FromOrdinal`, `AddDays`, `AddMonths`, `AddYears`, `IsLeapYear`, `DaysInMonth`, `Today`, `Format`, `Parse`

### enum `DateSelectionMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Single` | one date |
| `Range` | a contiguous start..end span (two clicks) |
| `Multiple` | an arbitrary set of individual dates (toggle) |
| `Week` | clicking any day selects its entire week (a 7-day span) |

### enum `CalendarViewLevel`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Days` | day grid for one month |
| `Months` | month grid for one year |
| `Years` | year grid for one decade |

### enum `CalendarNavMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Paged` | a fixed block of months; chevrons step forward/back |
| `Scrolling` | a scrollable strip of months driven by a scrollbar (chevrons kept too) |

### enum `CalendarOrientation`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Vertical` | months stacked top-to-bottom (vertical scrollbar) |
| `Horizontal` | months side-by-side left-to-right (horizontal scrollbar) |

### enum `DatePickerVariant`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `DropdownCalendar` | editable text field + button -&gt; popup calendar |

### enum `DateRangePickerMode`

How a from-to span (e.g. a hotel stay) is entered.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SingleField` | one field; start and end chosen in one process (two clicks in one calendar) |
| `TwoFields` | separate check-in and check-out fields, each with its own calendar |
